name: Healing Word
entries: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d4} plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The healing increases by {@scaledice 2d4|1-9|2d4} for each spell slot level above 1.
